entities.summary: Jalāl al-Dīn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Qazwīnī, commonly known as Jalāl al-Dīn al-Qazwīnī was a renowned Shāfiʿī jurist, linguist, judge, preacher, and scholar of Arabic rhetoric. He is most famous for refining and popularizing the science of balāgha, particularly through his two influential works: Talkhīṣ al-Miftāḥ and Al-Īḍāḥ fī ʿUlūm al-Balāgha. His writings became foundational in Islamic rhetorical education from the late medieval period onward, earning him recognition as one of the most influential scholars in the history of Arabic eloquence.
